name: Single Permit / EU Blue Card

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an employment contract with a Bulgarian employer, who initiates the Single Residence and Work Permit (or EU Blue Card, internal corporate transfer, or posted-worker permit) process with the Employment Agency.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Bulgarian employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Employer must obtain a labour market access permit from the Employment Agency (up to 30 days, BGN 100-400) before the worker applies for a Type D visa and residence permit.
Applicant must demonstrate sufficient funds for subsistence, at least the minimum monthly wage, without recourse to social assistance.

outcome.duration_length: residence permit issued up to 14 days after application, annual renewal; overall process (labour market permit + visa + residence permit + ID document) can take 2-3 months

sources.title: Ministry of Economy, Investments and Industry -- Hiring Employees Who Are Citizens of Other (Non-EU) States: four-stage process (labour market permit, Type D visa, residence permit, ID document), permit types (Single Permit, EU Blue Card, internal corporate transfer, seasonal), fees and timelines

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bulgaria). work_rights modeled 'restricted' because the permit is tied to the specific sponsoring employer/position, standard for employer-sponsored permits in this dataset. Did not model separate EU Blue Card salary-threshold specifics (a higher-skill variant with a different qualifying salary multiple exists per KPMG secondary sourcing on 2023 EU Blue Card amendments) as a distinct requirement group in this pass -- flagged as a gap for a future revisit if granular Blue Card salary figures are needed.
